name: Multi-pattern Volumetric Construction via Voxel Multiplication
aliases: Multi-pattern volumetric volume construction via voxel multiplication
Voxel value determination by pattern intersection
definition: A method to create cross-sectional images of a 3D structure that exhibits multiple 2D patterns by calculating voxel values based on the intersection of projection axes from the voxel to the original patterns.
summary: Multi-pattern Volumetric Construction via Voxel Multiplication encodes multiple 2D patterns into a single 3D volume by multiplying their projected pixel values, suppressing background noise unlike additive methods.
